description: Source code for SEAMA header fixup and MD5 checksum update in embedded systems, related to MTD devices.

methods.name: seama_fix_md5
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum and size in a SEAMA header within a file descriptor.

methods.name: mtd_fixseama
methods.description: Fixes the SEAMA header in an MTD device at a specified offset, updating MD5 checksum and rewriting the block.
